known_limits: Only Claude native backend; read-only tools and mocked MCP. No Codex execution adapter.
Actual paid Claude evaluation remains unexecuted in acceptance; account/model access not verified.
Native aggregate evidence remains diagnostic: per-run sessions, load receipts, complete cost allocation and human review are not fabricated.
Workstation interruption has no automatic continuation; unknown process/charge state blocks new paid starts.
Native cost is list-price estimate, may overrun in-flight and is not settled spending.
Local single-user service and byte hashes are not independent execution attestation.
Fresh desktop model conversation and public distribution not verified.
Comparison is descriptive; combined plugin/model changes cannot support single-factor attribution.
Cost coverage and settled labels are user declarations, not independent invoice verification; unknown categories prevent full-cost claims.

Research semantic reasoning is performed by the host Agent; deterministic local validation cannot establish source truth, novelty, exhaustive gaps or scientific validity. Skill auto-selection in a fresh desktop model conversation remains unverified.
